entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. S. A. Dhumal, Advocate for Petitioners.

Ms. Rashmi P. Gaur, Agp for Respondent Nos. 1, 2 & 4.
 Mr. M. N. Navandar, Advocate for Respondent No. 3.

Coram : Kishore C. Sant And
 Sushil M. Ghodeswar, Jj.
Date : 30th March, 2026.

Per Court :-
1.
Heard learned advocates for the parties and the learned A.G.P. for the State.

2. The petitioners have approached this Court seeking proceedings under section 24 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 (for short "Act of 2013").

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is the case that the earlier proceeding is filed as the petitioners are not paid compensation.

3. The learned advocate Mr. Dhumal for the petitioners 2 40-wp 14846-2017.odt vehemently argued the petition.
4.

The learned advocate Mr. Navandar for respondent No. 3 points out that, in the present case,
notification under section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act (for short "said Act") was issued on 31.01.2009.
Under section 6 of the said Act declaration was published on 10.12.2010 and award was passed on 01.12.2011 whereas, the petitioners have purchased the land on 24.10.2011.
The petitioners were aware of the acquisition proceedings and still they purchased the land.

The Junaid Musa Qureshi And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others on 30 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90908144/
1 compensation is, in fact, paid to the petitioners whose names standing on the date of notification under section 4 of the said Act.

entities.text: Junaid Musa Qureshi And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.P. has filed affidavit in reply.

In the affidavit also the case is the same as pointed out by learned advocate Mr. Navandar for respondent No. 3.
6.

The learned advocate Mr. Navandar for respondent No. 3 also relies upon the order passed by this Court in Writ Petition No. 4108/2017 dated 14.03.2023 wherein, in similar facts and circumstances,
this Court dismissed the writ petition.
It was kept open for the petitioners therein to take out any other proceeding if permissible and available under law.

The learned advocate also relies upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of The Secretary, Land & Building Department Govt. of NCT of Delhi and others Vs. Om Prakash (Dead)
Through L.Rs. And others, (2023) 20 SCC 785.
8.

entities.text:
Secretary, Land & Building Department Govt. of NCT of Delhi and others Vs. Om Prakash (Dead)
Through L.Rs. And others, (2023) 20 SCC 785
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of The Secretary, Land & Building Department Govt. of NCT of Delhi and others (supra), held that section 24 (2) of the Act of 2013 does not create new cause of action to challenge the order of finalized acquisition proceeding.

entities.text: Secretary, Land & Building Department Govt. of NCT of Delhi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is held to be applicable only to the cases wherein, acquisition proceeding was pending on 01.11.2014.
In the said case, the High Court had declared that the acquisition in the said case to have been lapsed.

The Hon'ble Apex Court relied upon the judgment in the case of Indore Development Authority Vs. Manoharlal and Ors.,
(2020) 8 SCC 129.
9.

entities.text:
Indore Development Authority Vs. Manoharlal and Ors.,
(2020) 8 SCC 129
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering above, this Court is convinced that there is no merit involved in the petition.
The writ petition stands disposed of.
10. It shall be open for the petitioners to take recourse to any other proceeding if permissible and available in law.
4 40-wp 14846-2017.odt 11. Needless to say that, time spent in prosecuting this petition shall not be come in the way in calculating the delay.
( SUSHIL M. GHODESWAR, J.) ( KISHORE C. SANT, J. )
